name: cache-timer
description: Prompt cache countdown with compact, keep warm, and an automatic action before it expires

autoMode.title: Auto action
autoMode.description: What happens on its own before the prompt cache expires, in a new chat (the band's auto button changes one chat): compact (at most once per idle stretch), keep warm (one tiny request; stops after 3 pings with no message from you), or off (a reminder instead).

minutesBeforeExpiry.title: Minutes before expiry
minutesBeforeExpiry.description: How long before the cache expires the auto action runs. 5 acts at 55 minutes on a 1h cache.

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: How long the prompt cache lives.
